title: CitizenshipBackExtractionSchema
description: Schema for structured extraction from the back of a Nepali Citizenship Certificate. Extract all variable information required to reproduce the English version of the certificate. Fixed labels are supplied by the document template and should not be extracted.

citizenship_no.description: Citizenship Certificate number exactly as printed in the top certificate details section. Preserve all digits, slashes, hyphens, and other separators exactly as shown. Do not infer or normalize.

sex.description: Sex of the certificate holder exactly as printed, such as 'Male' or 'Female'.

full_name.description: Full legal name of the certificate holder exactly as printed. Preserve spelling and spacing.

dob_year.description: Year of birth in AD exactly as printed.

dob_month.description: Month of birth in AD exactly as printed, such as 'JUL'.

dob_day.description: Day of birth in AD exactly as printed.

birth_district.description: District of the certificate holder's birth place exactly as printed.

birth_rm_mn.description: VDC, Rural Municipality, Municipality, or other local administrative unit of the birth place exactly as printed. Do not infer or translate the actual place name.

birth_ward_no.description: Ward number of the birth place exactly as printed.

perm_district.description: District of the permanent address exactly as printed.

perm_municipality.description: Municipality, Rural Municipality, VDC, or other local administrative unit of the permanent address exactly as printed. Do not infer or modify the place name.

perm_ward_no.description: Ward number of the permanent address exactly as printed.

nepal_citizenship_act_sentence.description: Translate the Nepali legal statement below the top information box into English. Return the complete English translation rather than the original Nepali text.

citizenship_type.description: Citizenship type indicated on the certificate. Translate the Nepali value into English. For example, 'वंशज' should be returned as 'By descent'.

right_thumb_impression.description: Determine whether a thumb impression is visible in the right thumb impression box. Return exactly 'present' or 'absent'.

left_thumb_impression.description: Determine whether a thumb impression is visible in the left thumb impression box. Return exactly 'present' or 'absent'.

copy_issue_date_bs.description: Date associated with issuance or certification of the copy/duplicate, in Bikram Sambat (BS). Extract exactly as printed, preserving numerals and separators.

copy_officer_signature.description: Signature of the officer who provided or certified the copy/duplicate. If visible but not reliably readable as text, return 'present'. If no signature is visible, return 'absent'.

copy_officer_name.description: Name of the officer who provided or certified the copy/duplicate. Extract the name as printed. If printed in Nepali, transliterate it into English characters for the generated English document.

copy_officer_designation.description: Designation of the officer who provided or certified the copy/duplicate. Translate the Nepali designation into English for the generated document.

issuing_officer_signature.description: Signature of the officer who originally issued the citizenship certificate. If visible but not reliably readable as text, return 'present'. If no signature is visible, return 'absent'.

issuing_officer_name.description: Name of the officer who originally issued the citizenship certificate. Extract the name as printed. If printed in Nepali, transliterate it into English characters for the generated English document.

issuing_officer_designation.description: Designation of the officer who originally issued the citizenship certificate. Translate the Nepali designation into English for the generated document.

issue_date_bs.description: Official issue date of the original citizenship certificate in Bikram Sambat (BS), exactly as printed. Preserve all numerals and separators.

remarks.description: Translate the bottom-of-page instruction into English. The instruction asks anyone who finds the certificate to hand it over to the nearest District Administration Office or Police Office. Return the complete English translation.
